documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Satin Creditcare Network Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, achieving a standalone H1 PAT of INR292 crores and consolidated H1 PAT of INR299 crores. Management highlighted a significant reduction in slippages and credit costs while prudently increasing the management overlay buffer to INR50 crores. The company remains on track to achieve its long-term consolidated AUM target of INR32,000 crores by 2030, with 30% coming from non-microfinance businesses. Furthermore, the promoters have committed INR100 crores through warrants, with the first tranche already received. Satin Creditcare Network Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results, highlighting significant growth in AUM, disbursements, and profitability across standalone and consolidated operations.

guidance.claim: The company expects to land within the guided range of 20% to 25% for full year consolidated AUM growth.
guidance.quote: The second half is seasonally a stronger period for disbursement, and on the basis of our current pipeline, we expect to land within the guided range for the full year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to open approximately 50-odd branches in the second half of the year.
guidance.quote: So I think the second half we will open close to about 50-odd branches, which will be there.

guidance.claim: Management stated that stable yearly net interest margin should be around 14.5%.
guidance.quote: So I think we can look at a stable yearly NIM of about 14.5%.

guidance.claim: Consolidated AUM is targeted to reach ₹32,000 Crores by FY2030.
guidance.quote: Consolidated AUM targeted to reach ₹32,000 Crores by FY-2030 : 52% of the Target Achieved

guidance.claim: The company guided for a consolidated AUM growth of 20% to 25% for FY27.
guidance.quote: Our guidance for FY27 is consolidated AUM growth of 20% to 25%, implying INR18,200 crores to INR18,900 crores by March '27.

guidance.claim: Management guided for stand-alone credit cost of 3% to 3.5% on a reported basis for FY27.
guidance.quote: Stand-alone credit cost of 3% to 3.5% on a reported basis.

guidance.claim: The company guided for a stand-alone return on assets of 3.5% to 4% on a reported basis for FY27.
guidance.quote: And stand-alone return on assets of 3.5% to 4%, again on a reported basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that rural cash flow recovery following the monsoon has been very encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: That period has now passed and the recovery has now been very encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Assam has almost fully recovered from floods with no discernible impact on credit cost.
demand_outlook.quote: Assam, where four districts were severely impacted by floods, has almost fully recovered with no discernible impact on our credit cost.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's exposure to drought-affected Karnataka and Maharashtra is negligible at 1% each of the on-book portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: Our exposure is negligible. Karnataka and Maharashtra account for 1% each of our on-book portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the second half of the year has seasonally higher growth.
Management stated that the industry has successfully transitioned from repair to expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: As for the sector, we can say with confidence that the industry has moved from repair to expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the revised monsoon outlook warrants caution regarding rural cash flows over the upcoming 2 to 3 months.
demand_outlook.quote: The revised monsoon outlook warrants caution on rural cash flows over the next 2 to 3 months.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the West Asia situation has had no discernible impact on the business to date.
demand_outlook.quote: The West Asia situation has had no discernible impact on our business to date.

capex_expansion.claim: Satin Finserv operated across 121 branches in 14 states.
capex_expansion.quote: Satin Finserv was a standout with AUM of INR1,360 crores, up 134% year-on-year and 29% sequentially across 121 branches in 14 states.

capex_expansion.claim: Satin Housing Finance operated across 57 branches in 22 states.
capex_expansion.quote: Satin Housing Finance stands at INR1,263 crores, up 31% year-on-year with CRAR at 59.8% across 57 branches in 22 states.

margins_costs.claim: The operating expense ratio was 6.6% compared to 7.2% a year ago.
margins_costs.quote: Our operating expense ratio was 6.6% against 7.2% a year ago.

margins_costs.claim: Marginal cost of borrowing reduced by 65 basis points year-on-year to 10.28%.
margins_costs.quote: Our marginal cost of borrowing reduced by 65 basis points year-on-year to 10.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Marginal borrowing cost reduced by 65 bps year-on-year to 10.28% in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Marginal borrowing cost reduced by 65bps YoY to 10.28% in Q2FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Stand-alone net interest margin improved to 14.36% from 13.16% on a gross yield of 22.44% against a cost of funds of 8.08%.
margins_costs.quote: On margins and efficiency, stand-alone NIM improved to 14.36% from 13.16% on gross yield of 22.44% against a cost of funds of 8.08%.

margins_costs.claim: The operating expense ratio improved to 6.33% from 6.98% in Q4.
margins_costs.quote: Our operating expense ratio improved to 6.33% from 6.98% in Q4 as the 392 branches added last year begin to season.

margins_costs.claim: Cost to income improved to 44.49% from 48.91% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Cost to income improved to 44.49% from 48.91% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: The reported credit cost for the quarter was 3.06%, which included a management overlay of INR36 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Our reported credit cost for the quarter was 3.06%, an improvement of over 175 basis points year-on-year and within our guided range of 3% to 3.5%. That reported figure includes a management overlay of INR36 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Excluding the overlay, the credit cost for the quarter was 1.97%.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding the overlay, our credit cost for the quarter was 1.97%.

orders_capacity.claim: Standalone AUM stood at INR13,608 crores, up 23% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Standalone AUM stood at INR13,608 crores, up 23% year- on- year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company serves 34.1 lakh clients across 2,075 branches, 27 states, and 5 union territories.
orders_capacity.quote: We serve 34.1 lakh clients across 2,075 branches, 27 states and 5 union territories, 608 districts, 4.1 lakh centres, and 1.14 lakh villages through 18,978 employees.

orders_capacity.claim: Standalone AUM stood at ₹13,608 Crores, marking a 23% growth YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: Standalone: AUM stands at ₹13,608 Crores, 23% growth YoY ; Disbursement ₹6,109 Crores, 36% growth YoY.

orders_capacity.claim: Consolidated AUM stood at ₹16,589 Crores, marking a 31% growth YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: Consolidated: AUM stands at ₹16,589 Crores, 31% growth YoY; Disbursement ₹7,192 Crores, 48% growth YoY.

orders_capacity.claim: Consolidated AUM reached INR15,935 crores, reflecting a 27% year-on-year and 5% sequential growth.
orders_capacity.quote: Consolidated AUM reached INR15,935 crores, growing 27% year-on-year and 5% sequentially.

orders_capacity.claim: Consolidated disbursements reached INR3,495 crores, marking a 56% year-on-year increase.
orders_capacity.quote: Consolidated disbursements were INR3,495 crores, up 56% year-on-year, with stand-alone disbursements at INR3,008 crores, up 46% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: X-bucket collection efficiency was reported at 99.9%.
orders_capacity.quote: X-bucket collection efficiency was 99.9% and every one of our top states is at 99.6% or better.

capital_allocation.claim: The company increased the management overlay from INR36 crores to INR50 crores this quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We have taken the management overlay from INR36 crores to INR50 crores this quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Total on-book borrowings were INR10,033 crores with a leverage ratio of 2.9x down from 3.2x.
capital_allocation.quote: Total on-book borrowings were INR10,033 crores with a leverage ratio of 2.9x down from 3.2x.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters have committed INR100 crores through warrants, and the first tranche of INR25 crores has been received.
capital_allocation.quote: The promoters have committed INR100 crores through warrants, and the first tranche of INR25 crores has already been received by the company.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters committed ₹100 Crores by warrants, with the first tranche of ₹25 Crores already received by the company.
capital_allocation.quote: Promoters committed ₹100 Crores by warrants, first tranche of ₹25 Crores already received by the company.

capital_allocation.claim: Standalone operations raised ~₹5,630 Crores in H1 FY27 via diversified debt instruments.
capital_allocation.quote: Standalone: - Raised ~₹5,630 Crores in H1FY27 via diversified debt instruments.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised approximately INR3,000 crores during the quarter through diversified instruments.
capital_allocation.quote: We raised approximately INR3,000 crores during the quarter through diversified instruments, including INR285 crores of subordinated debt, which took our subordinated liabilities to INR497 crores and supported a capital adequacy ratio of 26.74%, up from 25.39% in March.

capital_allocation.claim: Shareholders approved a promoter infusion of INR100 crores at approximately a 17% premium to the minimum issue price under SEBI regulation.
capital_allocation.quote: Shareholders have approved the promoter infusion of INR100 crores at approximately a 17% premium to the minimum issue price under SEBI regulation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company secured a INR2,000 crores direct assignment sanction limit from a public sector bank.
capital_allocation.quote: We secured a INR2,000 crores direct assignment sanction limit from a public sector bank through its first-ever digital direct assignment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Assam experienced severe floods impacting 3 districts, affecting approximately 44,000 borrowers with a portfolio outstanding of about INR149.83 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: For instance, Assam, one of our key states, where portfolio exposure is currently experiencing severe floods, while 3 districts, Jorhat, Sivasagar, and Charaideo have been impacted. The financial impact on our portfolio is significantly mitigated through our nat cat insurance coverage. Around 44,000 borrowers representing a portfolio outstanding of about INR149.83 crores have been affected, of which INR96.95 crores is covered under nat cat insurance.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to build a INR100 crores buffer for the company.
management_commitments.quote: Our internal target was that we'll probably close at about 100-odd crores.

management_commitments.claim: The company is on track to achieve the target of 30% non-MFI portfolio by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Non-MFI portfolio now stands at 20% of consolidated AUM against 15% a year ago, and we are on track to achieve the target of 30% by 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Consolidated AUM is targeted to reach ₹32,000 Crores by FY-2030.
management_commitments.quote: Consolidated AUM targeted to reach ₹32,000 Crores by FY-2030 : 52% of the Target Achieved

management_commitments.claim: Management guided for consolidated AUM growth of 20% to 25% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our guidance for FY27 is consolidated AUM growth of 20% to 25%, implying INR18,200 crores to INR18,900 crores by March '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management guided for stand-alone credit cost of 3% to 3.5% on a reported basis for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Stand-alone credit cost of 3% to 3.5% on a reported basis.

management_commitments.claim: Management targeted a non-MFI portfolio share of 30% by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: On diversification, non-MFI portfolio now stands at 99 -- sorry, 19% of consolidated AUM against 14% a year ago and a target of 30% by 2030.
